Create paint_front.png: ONE 1024 x 1024 RGBA texture-source painting with real transparent background. Return at native 1024 x 1024 resolution.

Paint ONLY the existing visible surfaces of input 1. Preserve its exact alpha silhouette and all object positions, scale, framing, camera projection, shapes, edges, holes, openings and details. Do not redraw or redesign the geometry. The object remains within the identical guide bounds (x=66..957, y=229..793) on the 1024 square canvas, with the same generous transparent margins. Keep every jagged shard, small spike and curved rib where the guide puts it; retain the five tall curved spines and small terminal hook in their precise guide locations, the front diagonal rail, irregular stern fracture on the left and pointed right end. Transfer the approved weathered grey-brown chitin and bone-plate materials, darker spines, black-violet resin webbing visible on the existing surfaces within openings, and dry dust. Use the reference's cracked, striated, chipped organic plate surfaces as colour texture within the guide geometry. Do not add strands, spikes, loose fragments or new openings, or extend any material beyond the guide silhouette. Keep muted natural grey-brown plate colours, dark brown-grey spines and subdued black-violet resin. Preserve all geometry even where the design reference is more elaborate.
LIGHTING: albedo texture source, even flat shadowless illumination from the viewer. Remove the guide's shading. No cast shadows, no ambient occlusion or directional darkening, no specular highlights or reflections, no rim light, no cinematic colour grading. Dark resin is dark because of its pigment, not because of shadow. Any existing emissive colour is painted only as local colour without illuminating neighbours; invent no glowing components.
No scene, background, floor, ground, labels, border or watermark. True alpha transparency, no opaque black or checkerboard background. Preserve guide silhouette pixel for pixel; surface repaint only.
